3469-5261-7014.easyPrerequisites:
Energy Arc is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
North Pole Patrol doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
3469-5261-7014.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Energy Arc without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Energy Arc, untapping all creatures you control
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3033-6972-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Vengeful Vampire
When Vengeful Vampire dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Vengeful Vampire
When Vengeful Vampire dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Hammerhead abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
3033-6972-8095.notes: If Vengeful Vampire starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

333-4247-5617.notablePrerequisites: Fungal Fortitude attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-4247-5617.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

1981-2415-4063-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Fleshtaker and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.
1981-2415-4063-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1496-1981-2415-5231.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1496-1981-2415-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

2738-2921-3220-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Golgari Germination, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Repeat.

523-3263.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block Hellkite Tyrant.
523-3263.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Hellkite Tyrant. Hellkite Tyrant triggers, causing you to gain control of all permanents that player controls, as they'll all be artifacts due to Mycosynth Lattice.
At the beginning of your upkeep, if you control twenty or more artifacts, Hellkite Tyrant will trigger, causing you to win the game.
523-3263.notes: You can repeat this loop during each of your turns, if desired and if you don't win the game from Hellkite Tyrant's trigger.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2665-3122.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2665-3122.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Undercover Operative and Progenitor Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Undercover Operative trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Progenitor Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2665-3122.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

147-2438-7682.notablePrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 4 or less.
147-2438-7682.description:
Cast Lively Dirge by paying {1}{B} plus an additional {2} to select its second mode, targeting a card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Lively Dirge.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Lively Dirge
Resolve the Lively Dirge copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

5220-6505-6794-6900.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1575-5226-5903.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing an artifact, which is a Food due to Gourmand's Talent.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-6972-7415.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Old-Growth Educator.
When Old-Growth Educator dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Old-Growth Educator enters, it triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2530-2577-6518-7399.easyPrerequisites: You control another Zombie if Gravecrawler is in your graveyard.
2530-2577-6518-7399.description:
Cast Gravecrawler either from your hand or graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Bogwater Lumaret, Carnival of Souls and The Sibsig Ceremony trigger.
Resolve the Bogwater Lumaret trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, destroying Gravecrawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When the Zombie Druid enters the battlefield, Bogwater Lumaret and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Bogwater Lumaret trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.

1687-5256-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
1687-5256-5972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2769-3259-6791.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2769-3259-6791.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Hanweir Garrison as attackers.
Hanweir Garrison triggers, creating two creature tokens
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3259-5659-7175.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5659-7175.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Disa the Restless's second ability.
Resolve the Disa the Restless trigger, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Tarmogoyf token, then causing untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2557-2919-4050-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2557-2919-4050-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3121-3967-6972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Marionette Master.
When Marionette Master dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Marionette Master enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

3532-4842-5078-5901.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Chasm Skulker triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1376-1978-5143.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Elves on the battlefield.
1376-1978-5143.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Priest of Titania.
Repeat

539-3045-3293-6798.easyPrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand with the mana to cast it.
You have a creature card in your graveyard.
539-3045-3293-6798.description:
Cast any creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters as a Plains due to Ashaya and Emeria Shepherd, Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature cast in step 1.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
539-3045-3293-6798.notes: You can forego step 3 as long as two or more creature cards are in your graveyard. This allows you to reanimate all creature cards in your graveyard if you wish.

5365-5445-6797.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one Clue.
5365-5445-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis' second ability and Tarrian's Soulcleaver trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Tarrian's Soulcleaver trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

277-5720-5721-6620.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
277-5720-5721-6620.description:
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
Resolve all Sylvan Safekeeper abilities.

1808-2438-6291.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature you control.
Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2060-2921-3693-5544-6431.manaNeeded: {B} if Crystalline Crawler does not have a +1/+1 counter on it
2060-2921-3693-5544-6431.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
If able, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Forsaken Miner enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Walking Ballista ability from step 3.
Repeat.

2440-4183-4404-5115.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Corridor Monitor
2440-4183-4404-5115.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Corridor Monitor with haste.
When the token Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Corridor Monitor trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Corridor Monitor, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Corridor Monitor for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Gemstone Array twice by paying {4}, putting two charge counters on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability twice by removing two charge counters from it, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

2558-2921-5687-5691.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Street Riot, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1140-1636-1648-3143.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1140-1636-1648-3143.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Nissa of Shadowed Boughs trigger.
Resolve the Nissa of Shadowed Boughs trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1494-2511-2527-3784-4275.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding an amount of {C} equal to Vhal's toughness that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Haunted One triggers, causing Humans and Wizards you control to get +2/+0 and to gain undying until end of turn.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Sage of Hours.
When Sage of Hours dies, its undying ability and Faces of the Past trigger.
Resolve the Sage of Hours trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Humans and Wizards.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1558-3529-4231-5400.notablePrerequisites:
Synth Infiltrator is a copy of Academy Manufactor.
Hoard Robber does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by at least one opponent.
1558-3529-4231-5400.description:
Attack with Hoard Robber.
Hoard Robber triggers on combat damage to a player, creating three Treasure tokens, three Food tokens, and three Clue tokens.
Activate Time Sieve's ability by tapping Time Sieve and sacrificing five artifacts you control, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

2724-2963-3987.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Teleportation Circle. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

4089-5011-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Glasspool Mimic, adding {R}.
When Glasspool Mimic dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Repeat.

811-1984-2191-4119.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal damage to any target.
NOTE: You will lose the game if your library has an odd number of cards and Angel's Grace is the bottom card.
811-1984-2191-4119.description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W} targeting Khârn.
Activate Kharn by paying {0}, choosing any target.
Cause that target to take damage, dealing that damage to Khârn instead, but instead preventing that damage and causing an opponent of your choice to gain control of Khârn.
Khârn triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Spiteful Visions triggers twice.
Activate the Martyrdom ability again by paying {0}, targeting yourself.
Resolve one Spiteful Visions trigger, dealing 1 damage to Khârn, but instead preventing that damage and causing Khârn's controller to give control of Khârn to one of their opponent.
Khârn triggers, causing its most recent former controller to draw two cards.
Spiteful Visions triggers twice.
Resolve one Spiteful Visions trigger, dealing 1 damage to that player.
Activate the Martyrdom ability again by paying {0}, targeting that same player.
Resolve another Spiteful Visions trigger, dealing 1 damage to Khârn, but instead preventing that damage and causing Khârn's controller to give control of Khârn to one of their opponent.
If you just lost control of Khârn, repeat steps 4 through 7.
If another player just lost control of Khârn, instead repeat steps 8 through 12.
Once you have no cards left in your library, cast Angel's Grace by paying {W} so you can't lose the game this turn.
Whenever you fail to draw from an empty library in step 4, resolve one of the remaining Spiteful Visions triggers created in step 5 and continue the loop from step 6.

92-1496-4658.notablePrerequisites: You have the highest life total or are tied for the highest life total.
92-1496-4658.description:
Activate Vizkopa Guildmage's second ability by paying {1}{W}{B}, causing each opponent to lose life when you gain life this turn.
Cast Soul of Eternity by paying {4}{W}{W}{W}.
Soul of Eternity enters the battlefield, triggering Verdant Sun's Avatar, causing you to gain life equal to Soul of Eternity's toughness.
Sanguine Bond triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

803-4242-4640-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Oathkeeper attached to Su-Chi.
"Samurai" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-4242-4640-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Su-Chi.
Su-Chi and Oathkeeper triggers.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Oathkeeper trigger, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Su-Chi's power.
Equip Oathkeeper to Su-Chi by paying {2}.
Repeat.

3492-3609-4164.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one experience counter.
Coretapper does not have summoning sickness.
3492-3609-4164.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it.
Meren's first ability triggers, giving you an experience counter.
Resolve Coretapper's ability, putting two additional charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Meren's second ability triggers, returning Coretapper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.
